Service Level Additional Terms and Conditions: (SLA) The service Provider on its part and through its resources shall ensure that 1. No Unauthorized Person(s) gain entry in the office premises and ob serve regulations for entry/exit from the office gate No theft or pilferage ta kes place in any of the property of the office building. 2. To take all necessary steps to safe guard and protect the property of the Department and take in the interest maintaining proper security of o ffice with due care and diligence. 3. To give such reports relating to Security matters at such frequency as may be demanded by the Department. 4. To provide complete security round the clock by changing the duty hours of the personnel in rotation of replacement subject to statutory Limit ations. 5. The Service Provider shall be responsible for all acts of Commission and omission on the part of its security Staff and will take Such preventive measure and precautions as may be deemed necessary for the Safety of th e property / material List contained in the office premises. 6. The service Provider will be Wholly and exclusively responsible for payment of wages to the persons engaged by it and compliance of all statu tory obligations on its respect of all payments of wages Act, 1936, Minimu m Wages Act,1948,EmployeesProvident funds and Miscellaneous provision s Act, 1952, ESI Act,1948, Workmen’s Compensation Act, 1923, and all ot her related Legislation as applicable and Department shall not incur any lia bility or additional expenditure whatsoever for the persons employer by th e service provider on account of the above mentioned obligations. 7. All Security Personnel should be provided by the Service Provider With proper uniform, including headgear, boots, shoes, Whistle, lathies and other material required for the smart turn out and efficient performance of the duties. 8. The service Provider shall ensure that the persons deputed by are medically fit.

9. It is clearly understood that the persons employed by the Service P rovider shall not be deemed to the employees of the Department and shall have no relationship of Employer/ Employees or Master / Servant with the Department. 10. The Department shall not be Liable to any claim for damages or co mpensation that might become payable to the employees of Service Provid er in the event of an accident resulting in any possible injury or death of an y employee of the service provider while performing their duty within/outsi de the premises referred to above or damage of any other kind. The Servic e Provider shall always keep the Department fully indemnified against any such claim or damage. 11. The persons deputed by the service Provider shall not interfere wit h the duties of the employees of the department. 12. The service provider should replace the security personnel within 4 8 hours as and when the Department makes any oral/written complaint ab out any of the named persons. 13. The Service Provider should pay the minimum rates of wages to the security personnel supplied to the Department and should disburse salaries/wages of contracted staff deployed at office location from their ow n sources first and then claim payment from the department along with sta tutory documents like PF, ESI etc as well as bank statement of payment do ne to the contracted staff. 14. The Security personnel deployed by the service provider to serve th e department as per the agreement shall while on duty take the necessary instructions from the authorized person by the service provider. 15. The service provider is responsible for the recovery of the property lost by the department or it shall reimburse full amount of loss of pilferage caused directly or indirectly without connivance of the security personnel. 16. If department suffers any loss or damage on account of negligence, default or theft on part of any of the employees/agents of the service provi der, then the service provider shall keep the department fully indemnified against against such loss or damage.

17. The service provider shall observe all laws, rules, regulations, order s and directions issued by the concerning for discharge of duties. Any cont ravention of such laws, rules, regulations, order and directions will be dee med to be breach of contract and the service provider shall be liable for all such consequence and is case of any such breach, if the department incurs any obligations then the service provider shall be responsible to reimburse the department any loss monetary or otherwise occasioned on account of such breach or contravention. 18. The service provider shall ensure and guarantee the behavior and h onesty of the personnel deputed by it. In case of any misconduct or any ot her damage or theft to the property of the department the service provider shall be responsible for such losses or damages. The personnel of the servi ce provider shall be liable to be searched at the gate. 19. The service provider shall not assign, transfer, charge, hypothecate or in any manner make over the contract to any other agency without the c onsent of the department in writing. 20. The Service provider shall not disclose any information concerning t he affairs of the department which may have come to its knowledge withou t the consent of the department in writing. The service provider and person nel deputed by it must sign appropriate confidentiality agreement/Non-disc losure agreement to protect confidential and sensitive information of the d epartment. 21. The Service provider will submit its bills/invoices through GeM portal every month and the same will be paid following due procedure in G eM having fulfilled satisfaction of the department its obligation under the c ontract. The department however reserves the right to make such deductio ns out of its expenses incurred by the department on behalf of the service provider for non performance of its part of the contract. 22. The contract will commence from 01-12-2026 to 30-11-2027 for a period of One Year However, the contract can be terminated by either pa rty on giving one month notice in advance. 23. If service provider commits breach of any conditions of contract or f ails to fulfill its obligations, the department shall be at liberty to terminate t he contract without any notice.

24. The Contract shall be valid from the date of signing of such agreem ent and shall continue to be in force in the same manner unless terminated or modified in writing. The contract/agreement is renewable subject to the satisfactory performance of the service provider and with such amendment s/modified of terms and conditions as may be mutually agreed to including rise in wages/service charges taking into account the increase in minimum wages by the Government of India after the contract comes in force. 25. The Service provider shall provide a performance security deposit 2 % of the value of contract in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft Dra wn infavour of Zonal Accounts Officer, CBDT, Visakhapatnam payable at Vi sakhapatnam or fixed deposit receipt from commercial bank or bank guara ntee from the commercial bank in an acceptable form of performance guar antee for safeguarding the interest of the department in all respects. The s ecurity deposit shall remain valid for period of 60 days beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations of the service provider. The securi ty deposit will be forfeited in the event of any violation of any of the terms and conditions of this bid by the bidder in the event of any verifiable compl iant of non-payment of minimum wages as per law. 26. On the expiry of contract as mentioned the service provider will wit hdraw all its personnel and clear their accounts by paying them all their leg al dues as required under the provision of industrial disputes Act,1947 or a ny other laws as applicable. 27. In case of any disputes on account of the termination of employme nt or non employment by the personnel of the service provider it shall be t he entire responsible of the service provider to pay and settle the same. 28. The service provider shall comply with all the order/awards passed by the competent authority/court in respect of the personnel engaged by it . Both bidder and buyer can add to or delete any of the terms and conditio ns with mutual consent. 29. In event of any dispute raising in respect of the clause(s) of the con tract the matter will be referred to the Income Tax Officer, Ward-1, TANUKU whose decision shall be binding on Service provider as well as Buyer Organ ization.
